rationale: The original entry premise relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA ($30.08-$30.09) acting as dynamic support for an immediate continuation breakout. Over the past 17 minutes, price has failed to advance past $30.11 despite the broader market grinding higher (SPY +2.41%), and has now broken firmly below the 9-EMA down to $29.95. With short-term momentum broken, closing early preserves capital rather than waiting for the $29.88 hard stop to be hit, while strong relative volume (5.72x) and price remaining above session VWAP ($29.67) make flipping short unattractive against a heavily bullish tape.
